topic: Two siblings inherit their grandmother's house
text: When Grandma passed away, she left us her house. It’s a quaint place, full of memories that now weigh heavily on my chest. I should feel more joyful, but the walls seem to echo her absence. My sister and I stand in the living room, a space she once filled with her laughter and the clinking of teacups. We should be celebrating this gift, a tangible piece of our heritage. Instead, I can't help but think of all the times I could have visited but didn’t, all the stories I didn’t listen to because I was too busy. The house feels like a reminder, a silent witness to the time that slipped away.
